title: Shopify REST to GraphQL mapping file

resource.description: The REST resource family these rules cover, for example 'product'.

id.description: Stable identifier, referenced in reports and tests.

status.description: direct: the operation replaces the REST call one for one. partial: it replaces it but the shape or semantics differ. manual: no single operation replaces it and a human has to decide.

notes.description: Traps that cost time if missed. Each one must be traceable to the linked documentation.

docs.description: The reference page this rule was written from.

path.description: Path relative to /admin/api/{version}/, with named segments in braces, for example 'products/{id}.json'.

rootField.description: The root field name, used to group and to check the document actually calls what the rule claims.

document.description: A complete, runnable operation. No ellipses, no placeholders beyond declared variables.

variables.description: Example variables for the document, with values that show the expected shape.

accessScopes.description: Scopes the operation requires, where the reference page states them.
